# Ehrenman & Khan Pediatric Dentistry

> A Long Island pediatric dental practice specializing in gentle, compassionate care for children including preventive, restorative, orthodontic, and sedation dentistry services.

Ehrenman & Khan Pediatric Dentistry, led by Dr. Glen Ehrenman and Dr. Mahnaz Khan, operates multiple locations across Nassau County (Westbury, Jericho, Syosset) and provides comprehensive pediatric dental care including special needs dentistry and hospital-based sedation services.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Long Island dental care
- Gentle dentistry
- Sedation dentistry
- Special needs dentistry
- Preventive dentistry
- Restorative and cosmetic dentistry
- Orthodontics and braces
- Child oral health
- Hospital dentistry
- Dr. Glen Ehrenman
- Dr. Mahnaz Khan
- Westbury office
- Jericho office
- Nassau County
